_comment: Education-feeds catalog (L7). A tiered address book of trusted feeds the self-updater harvests. Authoritative-first: only tier 'canonical' / authority 'primary' confirms a change; 'news_teacher_student' is curated secondary news on issues affecting teachers/students; the 'product_updates' layer (edtech/vendor) is OFF by default. Feeds come in two types: type='feed' (native RSS/Atom — fetched and parsed directly) and type='page' (HTML news-listing page without a feed — harvested by the page scraper in shared/feeds/feeds.py scrape_page_items(), driven by the scrape_config block). Page scrapers need site-specific selector tuning; run tools/make_feed.py --url URL to discover selectors. Standards/program changes are advisory + human-verified. PROVENANCE (updated 2026-08-16): the build environment DOES have egress, and every entry was fetched once with tools/verify_feeds.py on that date. 2 of 14 yielded a parseable feed and are verified:true with a proof_latest_item receipt; the other 12 carry a dated probe_history entry naming what was tried and what came back. The previous note here said none had been confirmed 'in the build environment (egress-restricted)' and described a url_status vocabulary ('unverified_candidate') that no entry actually used — the reason had expired and the description never matched. Promotion still requires a PARSED feed with a proof item; a page that merely answers 200 is never verified.py on an open network before it is trusted. Base domains are real; deep RSS/news paths are best-guess patterns. Nothing is presented as confirmed that was not actually fetched. PROVENANCE (2026-11-07): edsecledger added after a same-day tools/verify_feeds.py pass (parsed feed + proof item) — 3 of 15 are verified:true. The feed updater itself had been crashing on the bare-date last_checked stamps since 2026-06-28; fixed in shared/feeds/feeds.py the same day, with a CI self-test. PROVENANCE (2026-11-13): first curator pass (tools/seed_curator.py --validate, then one approved proposal, ledger fc-0002..fc-0007). cast-udl-news moved from the dead page cast.org/news to CAST's RSS feed (verified same day); fl-senate-calendars repointed to the Senate's DailyCalendar feed (valid RSS, empty between sessions, so still verified:false); wida-news, ascd-blog and nctm-news removed (404, no feed found, page scraper found 0 items) and parked in feed_candidates.json. ed-gov-news and fldoe-news refuse cloud fetches (403 on every prong) and are left as they are. 3 of 12 are verified:true.

product_updates.note: edtech/vendor product-update feeds — OFF unless a teacher opts in

redistribution.note: When true, tools/feeds_publish.py leaves every feed marked redistribute:false out of the git-shareable snapshot (their publishers allow linking, not republishing). Off since 2026-11-13 by the owner's decision; with it off, the export warns and lists those feeds instead.
